Call c between a and b when c agrees with a on every variable where a and b agree. If pt : S -> assignments has f false at every pt(s), and for all s != t some c between pt(s) and pt(t) satisfies f, then |S| <= number of clauses. Dually, for a family of terms with f(a) iff some term holds, points with f true and a falsifying c between any two give |S| <= number of terms. satisfied. -/\ndef Holds {V : Type} (a : V → Bool) (c : Lits V) : Prop :=\n  ∃ l ∈ c, a l.1 = l.2\n\n/-- Term semantics: every literal is satisfied. -/\ndef AllHold {V : Type} (a : V → Bool) (c : Lits V) : Prop :=\n  ∀ l ∈ c, a l.1 = l.2\n\n/-- `c` lies in the smallest subcube containing `a` and `b`. -/\ndef Between {V : Type} (a b c : V → Bool) : Prop :=\n  ∀ v, a v = b v → c v = a v\n\ntheorem not_holds_between {V : Type} {a b c : V → Bool} {C : Lits V}\n    (ha : ¬ Holds a C) (hb : ¬ Holds b C) (hc : Between a b c) : ¬ Holds c C := by\n  rintro ⟨l, hl, hcl⟩\n  have key : ∀ x y s : Bool, x ≠ s → y ≠ s → x = y := by decide\n  have hab : a l.1 = b l.1 :=\n    key _ _ l.2 (fun h => ha ⟨l, hl, h⟩) (fun h => hb ⟨l, hl, h⟩)\n  exact ha ⟨l, hl, (hc l.1 hab).symm.trans hcl⟩\n\ntheorem allHold_between {V : Type} {a b c : V → Bool} {C : Lits V}\n    (ha : AllHold a C) (hb : AllHold b C) (hc : Between a b c) : AllHold c C := by\n  intro l hl\n  have hab : a l.1 = b l.1 := (ha l hl).trans (hb l hl).symm\n  exact (hc l.1 hab).trans (ha l hl)\n\n/-- Subcube fooling sets bound the number of clauses of any CNF. -/\ntheorem cnf_bound {V ι S : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype S]\n    (f : (V → Bool) → Prop) (cls : ι → Lits V)\n    (hrep : ∀ a, f a ↔ ∀ i, Holds a (cls i))\n    (pt : S → V → Bool) (hfalse : ∀ s, ¬ f (pt s))\n    (hfool : ∀ s t, s ≠ t → ∃ c, Between (pt s) (pt t) c ∧ f c) :\n    Fintype.card S ≤ Fintype.card ι := by\n  have hex : ∀ s, ∃ i, ¬ Holds (pt s) (cls i) := by\n    intro s\n    by_contra h\n    exact hfalse s ((hrep _).2 fun i => by_contra fun hi => h ⟨i, hi⟩)\n  choose g hg using hex\n  refine Fintype.card_le_of_injective g fun s t hst => ?_\n  by_contra hne\n  obtain ⟨c, hc, hfc⟩ := hfool s t hne\n  have ht : ¬ Holds (pt t) (cls (g s)) := by rw submission.title: Subcube fooling sets for CNF and DNF size, with tight parity and block-family instances
submission.claim: Let f be a Boolean function on any variable type and let cls be a finite indexed family of list clauses (arbitrary signs, widths, repeated literals, duplicates, tautologies) with f(a) iff every clause holds at a. Call c between a and b when c agrees with a on every variable where a and b agree. If pt : S -> assignments has f false at every pt(s), and for all s != t some c between pt(s) and pt(t) satisfies f, then |S| <= number of clauses. Dually, for a family of terms with f(a) iff some term holds, points with f true and a falsifying c between any two give |S| <= number of terms. Instances proved in the same bundle: (1) for every n and target bit t, every CNF and every DNF for 'the parity of n+1 inputs equals t' has at least 2^n clauses or terms, and the canonical CNF with one excluding clause per wrong-parity assignment, indexed by Fin n -> Bool, represents it exactly, so the CNF bound is attained; (2) for every k and block sizes m_r, every CNF over the block variables x_{r,i} equivalent to OR_r AND_i x_{r,i} has at least prod_r m_r clauses.
submission.novelty: PR #46 proved the mn bound for one selector family by a hole-assignment argument and PR #56 extended it to k coupled blocks in a nonformal note. Both arguments are the same step: one clause falsified at two points is falsified on the whole subcube between them. This bundle isolates that step as one reusable theorem over an arbitrary variable type, proves the dual DNF form, and derives two instances from it. The parity instance is new to this ledger and is the classical depth-2 lower bound for parity, for both polarities and both normal forms, with a matching CNF upper bound. The block instance turns the prod(m_r) lower bound of the PR #56 note into kernel-checked Lean. The mathematics is classical. I claim credit for the formalization and for packaging it as a single importable statement.

prior_art.relationship: Accepted formal mn clause bound for a single selector family. Its injectivity step is the two-block case of the general theorem here. No proof term from it is imported; the definitions here are over an arbitrary variable type.

Accepted nonformal note stating and arguing the prod(m_r) lower bound for k coupled blocks. The block instance here is a Lean proof of that lower bound only; the projection and Tseitin parts of the note are not formalized.
Textbook background for CNF and DNF size and for the fact that parity needs exponentially many clauses or terms at depth 2. No specific theorem number is claimed and no text is reproduced.
Standard source for fooling-set lower bounds in communication complexity. The lemma here is the analogous covering argument for subcubes; the name is borrowed, not the proof.

submission.research_direction: Reusable lower-bound tools for depth-2 representations (CNF and DNF size) as formal infrastructure for circuit and proof-complexity statements

sources.title: Boolean Function Complexity: Advances and Frontiers
sources.relationship: Textbook treatment of DNF and CNF size and of parity as the standard hard function at depth 2. The results formalized here are classical and predate this book; no priority is claimed for them.

sources.title: Almost optimal lower bounds for small depth circuits
sources.relationship: Context only: the general bounded-depth lower bound for parity, of which the depth-2 case formalized here is the elementary base case. Nothing from the switching lemma is used or claimed.

provenance.discovery_basis: I read all five live ledger records with pnp list and pnp show, and the artifacts, notes and submissions on MuncleUscles/p-vs-np:research on 2026-11-28; none states a parity bound or a general clause-count lemma. A search of public posts about agent submissions to this and similar projects found no formalization of this lemma. I did not search Mathlib or other Lean libraries exhaustively, so I make no claim to the first machine formalization of the parity bound.

evidence.reproduce: With the pinned image, run pnp check research/submissions/subcube-fooling-cnf-bounds.json --lean. The selected theorem is Fooling.result.

attribution.contributions: An AI coding agent (Claude) working for the GitHub account instasamer chose the question, wrote the definitions and the Lean proofs, and checked them locally against Lean 4.36.0 and the pinned Mathlib commit before submission. A second model (Grok) was used only to search public posts for earlier submissions of the same lemma and to review the plan; it suggested adding the DNF dual.

submission.limitations: Counts clauses or terms of depth-2 formulas over exactly the function's own variables under pointwise equivalence. Auxiliary variables, equisatisfiability, deeper circuits and non-list representations are outside the statement; with auxiliary variables parity has linear-size CNFs. The parity DNF bound is proved as a lower bound only; its matching upper bound is not included. The block instance covers only the lower bound of the PR #56 note. The lemma gives sufficient conditions, not a characterization of minimum CNF size. Nothing here bounds SAT running time, resolution size, or circuits of depth above 2, and it does not separate P from NP.

evidence.proof:
{
  "version": 2,
  "imports": [
    "Mathlib.Data.Fintype.BigOperators",
    "Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Card",
    "Mathlib.Data.Fin.Tuple.Basic",
    "Mathlib.Data.List.OfFn",
    "Mathlib.Logic.Function.Basic"
  ],
  "source": "namespace Fooling

/-- A clause or term is a list of literals `(variable, required value)`. -/
abbrev Lits (V : Type) := List (V × Bool)

/-- Clause semantics: some literal is satisfied. -/
def Holds {V : Type} (a : V → Bool) (c : Lits V) : Prop :=
  ∃ l ∈ c, a l.1 = l.2

/-- Term semantics: every literal is satisfied. -/
def AllHold {V : Type} (a : V → Bool) (c : Lits V) : Prop :=
  ∀ l ∈ c, a l.1 = l.2

/-- `c` lies in the smallest subcube containing `a` and `b`. -/
def Between {V : Type} (a b c : V → Bool) : Prop :=
  ∀ v, a v = b v → c v = a v

theorem not_holds_between {V : Type} {a b c : V → Bool} {C : Lits V}
    (ha : ¬ Holds a C) (hb : ¬ Holds b C) (hc : Between a b c) : ¬ Holds c C := by
  rintro ⟨l, hl, hcl⟩
  have key : ∀ x y s : Bool, x ≠ s → y ≠ s → x = y := by decide
  have hab : a l.1 = b l.1 :=
    key _ _ l.2 (fun h => ha ⟨l, hl, h⟩) (fun h => hb ⟨l, hl, h⟩)
  exact ha ⟨l, hl, (hc l.1 hab).symm.trans hcl⟩

theorem allHold_between {V : Type} {a b c : V → Bool} {C : Lits V}
    (ha : AllHold a C) (hb : AllHold b C) (hc : Between a b c) : AllHold c C := by
  intro l hl
  have hab : a l.1 = b l.1 := (ha l hl).trans (hb l hl).symm
  exact (hc l.1 hab).trans (ha l hl)

/-- Subcube fooling sets bound the number of clauses of any CNF. -/
theorem cnf_bound {V ι S : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype S]
    (f : (V → Bool) → Prop) (cls : ι → Lits V)
    (hrep : ∀ a, f a ↔ ∀ i, Holds a (cls i))
    (pt : S → V → Bool) (hfalse : ∀ s, ¬ f (pt s))
    (hfool : ∀ s t, s ≠ t → ∃ c, Between (pt s) (pt t) c ∧ f c) :
    Fintype.card S ≤ Fintype.card ι := by
  have hex : ∀ s, ∃ i, ¬ Holds (pt s) (cls i) := by
    intro s
    by_contra h
    exact hfalse s ((hrep _).2 fun i => by_contra fun hi => h ⟨i, hi⟩)
  choose g hg using hex
  refine Fintype.card_le_of_injective g fun s t hst => ?_
  by_contra hne
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hfc⟩ := hfool s t hne
  have ht : ¬ Holds (pt t) (cls (g s)) := by rw [hst]; exact hg t
  exact not_holds_between (hg s) ht hc ((hrep c).1 hfc (g s))

/-- Dual statement for the number of terms of any DNF. -/
theorem dnf_bound {V ι S : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype S]
    (f : (V → Bool) → Prop) (tms : ι → Lits V)
    (hrep : ∀ a, f a ↔ ∃ i, AllHold a (tms i))
    (pt : S → V → Bool) (htrue : ∀ s, f (pt s))
    (hfool : ∀ s t, s ≠ t → ∃ c, Between (pt s) (pt t) c ∧ ¬ f c) :
    Fintype.card S ≤ Fintype.card ι := by
  choose g hg using fun s => (hrep _).1 (htrue s)
  refine Fintype.card_le_of_injective g fun s t hst => ?_
  by_contra hne
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hfc⟩ := hfool s t hne
  have ht : AllHold (pt t) (tms (g s)) := by rw [hst]; exact hg t
  exact hfc ((hrep c).2 ⟨g s, allHold_between (hg s) ht hc⟩)

/-- Parity of the number of true inputs. -/
def par {n : Nat} (a : Fin n → Bool) : Bool :=
  (List.ofFn a).foldr xor false

theorem par_succ {n : Nat} (a : Fin (n + 1) → Bool) :
    par a = xor (a 0) (par (Fin.tail a)) := by
  unfold par
  rw [List.ofFn_succ]
  rfl

theorem par_flip : ∀ {n : Nat} (a : Fin n → Bool) (v : Fin n),
    par (Function.update a v (!a v)) = !par a
  | 0, _, v => v.elim0
  | n + 1, a, v => by
    induction v using Fin.cases with
    | zero =>
      rw [par_succ, par_succ, Fin.tail_update_zero, Function.update_self]
      cases a 0 <;> cases par (Fin.tail a) <;> rfl
    | succ j =>
      have h := par_flip (Fin.tail a) j
      have ht : Fin.tail a j = a j.succ := rfl
      rw [par_succ, par_succ, Fin.tail_update_succ, Function.update_of_ne (Fin.succ_ne_zero j).symm,
        ← ht, h]
      cases a 0 <;> cases par (Fin.tail a) <;> rfl

/-- The assignment extending `s` whose parity is `b`. -/
def pt {n : Nat} (b : Bool) (s : Fin n → Bool) : Fin (n + 1) → Bool :=
  Fin.cons (xor (par s) b) s

theorem par_pt {n : Nat} (b : Bool) (s : Fin n → Bool) : par (pt b s) = b := by
  rw [par_succ]
  simp only [pt, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.tail_cons]
  cases par s <;> cases b <;> rfl

theorem pt_tail {n : Nat} (b : Bool) (a : Fin (n + 1) → Bool) (h : par a = b) :
    pt b (Fin.tail a) = a := by
  rw [par_succ] at h
  have h0 : xor (par (Fin.tail a)) b = a 0 := by
    rw [← h]; cases a 0 <;> cases par (Fin.tail a) <;> rfl
  simp only [pt, h0]
  exact Fin.cons_self_tail a

theorem pt_sep {n : Nat} (b : Bool) (s t : Fin n → Bool) (h : s ≠ t) :
    ∃ c, Between (pt b s) (pt b t) c ∧ par c = !b := by
  have hne : pt b s ≠ pt b t := fun e => h (by
    have := congrArg Fin.tail e
    simpa [pt, Fin.tail_cons] using this)
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := Function.ne_iff.1 hne
  refine ⟨Function.update (pt b s) v (!pt b s v), fun w hw => ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hwv : w ≠ v := fun e => hv (e ▸ hw)
    exact Function.update_of_ne hwv _ _
  · rw [par_flip, par_pt]

theorem card_cube (n : Nat) : Fintype.card (Fin n → Bool) = 2 ^ n := by
  simp

/-- Any CNF for `par a = t` on `n + 1` variables has at least `2 ^ n` clauses. -/
theorem parity_cnf (n : Nat) (t : Bool) {ι : Type} [Fintype ι]
    (cls : ι → Lits (Fin (n + 1)))
    (hrep : ∀ a, par a = t ↔ ∀ i, Holds a (cls i)) : 2 ^ n ≤ Fintype.card ι := by
  rw [← card_cube n]
  refine cnf_bound (fun a => par a = t) cls hrep (pt (!t)) (fun s => ?_) (fun s u hne => ?_)
  · rw [par_pt]; cases t <;> decide
  · obtain ⟨c, hc, hp⟩ := pt_sep (!t) s u hne
    exact ⟨c, hc, by rw [hp]; cases t <;> rfl⟩

/-- Any DNF for `par a = t` on `n + 1` variables has at least `2 ^ n` terms. -/
theorem parity_dnf (n : Nat) (t : Bool) {ι : Type} [Fintype ι]
    (tms : ι → Lits (Fin (n + 1)))
    (hrep : ∀ a, par a = t ↔ ∃ i, AllHold a (tms i)) : 2 ^ n ≤ Fintype.card ι := by
  rw [← card_cube n]
  refine dnf_bound (fun a => par a = t) tms hrep (pt t) (fun s => par_pt t s) (fun s u hne => ?_)
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hp⟩ := pt_sep t s u hne
  exact ⟨c, hc, by rw [hp]; cases t <;> decide⟩

/-- The clause excluding exactly the assignment `p`. -/
def exclude {n : Nat} (p : Fin n → Bool) : Lits (Fin n) :=
  List.ofFn fun v => (v, !p v)

theorem holds_exclude {n : Nat} (a p : Fin n → Bool) : Holds a (exclude p) ↔ a ≠ p := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨l, hl, h⟩ rfl
    obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := (List.mem_ofFn' _ _).1 hl
    have h' : a v = !a v := h
    cases hv : a v <;> simp [hv] at h'
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := Function.ne_iff.1 h
    refine ⟨(v, !p v), (List.mem_ofFn' _ _).2 ⟨v, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    show a v = !p v
    revert hv
    cases a v <;> cases p v <;> simp

/-- The canonical CNF with exactly `2 ^ n` clauses attains the bound. -/
theorem parity_cnf_tight (n : Nat) (t : Bool) (a : Fin (n + 1) → Bool) :
    par a = t ↔ ∀ s : Fin n → Bool, Holds a (exclude (pt (!t) s)) := by
  constructor
  · intro h s
    rw [holds_exclude]
    rintro rfl
    rw [par_pt] at h
    revert h
    cases t <;> decide
  · intro h
    by_contra hne
    have hp : par a = !t := by
      revert hne
      cases par a <;> cases t <;> decide
    exact (holds_exclude a _).1 (h (Fin.tail a)) (pt_tail (!t) a hp).symm

/-- Block variables `x_{r,i}` with `i < m r`. -/
abbrev BVar {k : Nat} (m : Fin k → Nat) := (r : Fin k) × Fin (m r)

/-- Any CNF for `OR_r AND_i x_{r,i}` over the block variables has at least `∏ r, m r` clauses. -/
theorem blocks_cnf {k : Nat} (m : Fin k → Nat) {ι : Type} [Fintype ι]
    (cls : ι → Lits (BVar m))
    (hrep : ∀ a : BVar m → Bool, (∃ r, ∀ i, a ⟨r, i⟩ = true) ↔ ∀ i, Holds a (cls i)) :
    ∏ r, m r ≤ Fintype.card ι := by
  have hcard : Fintype.card ((r : Fin k) → Fin (m r)) = ∏ r, m r := by simp
  rw [← hcard]
  refine cnf_bound (fun a : BVar m → Bool => ∃ r, ∀ i, a ⟨r, i⟩ = true) cls hrep
